Senses.Explanation: “Elegant even where there is no elegance” makes lack of polish the very site where an encounter can show its style. Questioning monks offer it after forceful answers, while later masters use it for inherited cases, a raised staff, or Zhaozhou’s handling. The line can praise but does not guarantee approval: several replies immediately counter it.
